text.original: Habitable Room: A room occupied or designed for occupancy by one or more persons for study, living, sleeping, eating and kitchen if it is used as living room, but not including bathrooms, water closet compartments, laundries serving and storage pantries, corridors, cellars, attics and spaces that are not used frequently or during extended periods.
